source.text: ወይደመስሱ፡ ኵሎ፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ *ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወእለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ መትሕተ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ሰማይ።
source.note: The selected active plural destruction predicate is translated they will wipe out, with no new named agent. Original1088-1089 controls the destruction root;613-614 the dwelling verb;1071-1072 dry land;555 beneath;1294-1295 ends/extremities; and341 heaven. Both inhabitant clauses and all are retained. The selected star on upon and the selected final-o quantifier remain in source; neither a passive verb nor a modern cosmology has been substituted.

translation.text: And they will wipe out all those who dwell on dry land and those who dwell beneath the ends of heaven.[a]
